CustomField.description: Base64-encoded captured payload (photo/file bytes, audio bytes, or the manual-order JSON) written by the chat guest, who cannot create Salesforce Files. Analyze Order, running as the agent user, decodes this into a real ContentVersion so the existing extraction/transcription paths work. Capped at ~96 KB binary by the field limit; the capture UI downscales photos to fit.
CustomField.label: Capture Data
